description: NSW Government Railways and Tramways Roll of Honour, 1914-1919 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Museums of History NSW. Name search for railway employees who died in the First World War. This index contains 1214 entries and was compiled from one volume by the State Records NSW Volunteer program. Click here for more information about this index. Coverage: Museums of History NSW. The portal files it under the publisher Museums of History NSW. Its tags are culture, history, railways, tramways. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-06-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
